writeup: This new Walker's foam ear plugs 1000-pair box (model GWP-FOAMPLUG1000BX, UPC 888151099933) is $69.99. The plugs are NRR 30dB and come individually wrapped. The Gun Shop USA has the same 1000-pair box in stock at $146.59, with Abide Armory at $149.58, Battlefield Tactical at $156.38, and Arms East at $163.18, so this is 52% and about $77 below the lowest of those live prices. Woot showed 10+ left, with a limit of 10 per customer.
